teaser.en: A plant that looks like a burr-weed but has no burrs, so the Digo named it half jirimata, half futswe.
teaser.sw: Mmea unaofanana na gugu lenye miiba-ndoano lakini hauna miiba hiyo, kwa hivyo Wadigo waliupa jina nusu jirimata, nusu futswe.
teaser.dg: Unaonekana dza mbondo wenye matunda ga miya, ela tauna miya, kpwa hivyo Adigo anauiha *jirimata futswe*: seemu mwenga *jirimata*, seemu yanjina *futswe*.

summary.en: Jirimata futswe is a soft, purple-flowered herb of the acanthus family. Its double name says that it has the shape of the burr-bearing jirimata but the harmless fruits of futswe.
summary.sw: Jirimata futswe ni mmea mdogo laini wenye maua ya zambarau wa familia ya acanthus. Jina lake la sehemu mbili linasema kwamba una umbo la jirimata lenye miiba-ndoano lakini matunda yasiyo na madhara ya futswe.
summary.dg: *Jirimata futswe* ni mmea laini wenye maruwa ga zambarau, wa jamii ya *acanthus*. Dzinare ra maneno mairi rinaonyesa kukala una umbo ra *jirimata*, ambayo matundage gana miya, ela matundage tagana ubaya, dza ga *futswe*.

about.en: Jirimata futswe is a soft-stemmed perennial herb or small shrub, usually under a metre tall. It has hairy leaves in opposite pairs. The flowers sit in clusters along the upper stems: small and two-lipped, mauve-pink to purple, often marked with darker lines, with a showy upper lip. Plants in flower can look like a purple haze, which is where the English name comes from. Digo people identify it by its fruits.
about.sw: Jirimata futswe ni mmea mdogo wa kudumu au kichaka kidogo chenye mashina laini, kwa kawaida chini ya mita moja kwa urefu. Una majani yenye manyoya yanayoota kwa jozi zinazotazamana. Maua hukaa kwa vishada kando ya sehemu za juu za mashina: ni madogo na yenye midomo miwili, ya waridi-zambarau hafifu hadi zambarau, mara nyingi yenye mistari mieusi zaidi, na mdomo wa juu unaovutia. Mimea ikichanua inaweza kuonekana kama ukungu wa zambarau, na hapo ndipo jina la Kiingereza linapotoka. Wadigo huutambua kwa matunda yake.
about.dg: *Jirimata futswe* ni mmea laini unaokala kpwa myaka minji, au chitsaka chidide, na mara nyinji tauphiya dzulu kuriko mita mwenga. Makodzage gana nyere na ganamera jozi-jozi ganalolana. Maruwa ganamera kpwa makundi kanda-kanda ya seemu ya dzulu ya mihi: ni madide genye miromo miiri, ga zambarau ngushu-ngushu na pinki hadi zambarau, mara nyinji genye mistari ya rangi nzito zaidi, na mromo wa dzulu unaoonekana sana. Mimea ichikala na maruwa inaweza kuonekana dza mosi wa zambarau, na ndiko dzina ra Chingereza rinakolavywa. Adigo anaumanya kpwa matundage.

where.en: It grows at forest edges, in shady bush and on grassy slopes, often in groups.
where.sw: Hukua pembezoni mwa misitu, vichakani kivulini na kwenye miteremko yenye nyasi, mara nyingi kwa makundi.
where.dg: Unamera kanda-kanda ya matsaka, vitsakani phatu phenye chivuri-vuri na kanda-kanda ya myango yenye nyasi, mara nyinji uchimera manji-manji.

culture.en: The name shows how Digo people place a plant between two familiar ones. According to Pakia, it 'takes the form' of *jirimata*, the burr-grass *Cenchrus mitis*. It lacks the thorny fruits, though, and so resembles *futswe* (*Asystasia gangetica*), the soft creeping herb.
culture.sw: Jina hili linaonyesha jinsi Wadigo wanavyoweka mmea kati ya mimea miwili inayojulikana. Kwa mujibu wa Pakia, 'unachukua umbo' la *jirimata*, nyasi yenye miiba-ndoano *Cenchrus mitis*. Hata hivyo hauna matunda yenye miiba, na kwa hivyo unafanana na *futswe* (*Asystasia gangetica*), mmea mdogo laini unaotambaa.
culture.dg: Dzina hiri rinaonyesa vira Adigo anavyoika mmea kahi ya mimea miiri inayomanyikana. Pakia anagomba kukala 'unahala umbo' ra *jirimata*, nyasi ya matunda ga miya *Cenchrus mitis*. Ela tauna matunda genye miya, na kpwa hivyo unahalana na *futswe* (*Asystasia gangetica*), mmea laini unaoambala.

names.en: Digo: *jirimata futswe*. Pakia gives the English name Purple Haze; it is also called ribbon bush. No Swahili name is recorded. Its relative *Hypoestes forskaolei* is *chibaruti*.
names.sw: Kidigo: *jirimata futswe*. Pakia anatoa jina la Kiingereza *Purple Haze*; pia unaitwa *ribbon bush*. Hakuna jina la Kiswahili lililorekodiwa. Ndugu yake *Hypoestes forskaolei* ni *chibaruti*.
names.dg: Dzina ra Chidigo ni *jirimata futswe*. Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chingereza *Purple Haze*; piya unaihwa *ribbon bush*. Takuna dzina ra Chiswahili ririroandikpwa. Nduguye *Hypoestes forskaolei* ni *chibaruti*.

reason.en: Jirimata lume, the burr-grass whose form it shares
reason.sw: Jirimata lume, nyasi yenye miiba-ndoano ambayo unashiriki umbo lake
reason.dg: *Jirimata lume*, nyasi ya matunda ga miya ambayo mmea uhu una umbo sawa nayo

reason.en: Futswe, the soft herb its fruits resemble
reason.sw: Futswe, mmea laini ambao matunda yake yanafanana nayo
reason.dg: *Futswe*, mmea laini ambao matundage ganahalana na ga mmea uhu

reason.en: Another plant in the jirimata group
reason.sw: Mmea mwingine wa kundi la jirimata
